_comment: The 'Your Ithaca' reflection. Brain fills the {placeholders} at end_session; Stage renders it on /card.
title: Your Ithaca

fields.label: Your storm
fields.hint: The user's problem in their own words, under 12 words.

fields.label: From the Odyssey
fields.hint: One keyQuote from that episode, with its passage id, e.g. 12.13.

fields.label: The lesson
fields.hint: One of the episode's lessons, reworded for the user.

fields.label: This week
fields.hint: One concrete action the user agreed to, starting with a verb.

example.problem: I keep scrolling my phone instead of studying

quote.text: If I beg and pray you to set me free, then bind me more tightly still.

example.lesson: Don't trust willpower in the moment; tie yourself to the mast beforehand.
example.action: leave your phone in the kitchen for your first two study hours each evening.
